Information

Dot Box is a premium, modern interpretation of the classic Dots & Boxes pen-and-paper game.

Programmed using pure HTML5, CSS3, and high-performance client-side Javascript. It features responsive layouts, advanced game state machines, simulated minimax AI, and Web Audio API synthesized audio.

Version 1.0.0

Your privacy is fully respected. Dot Box runs completely locally on your device:

  • No network tracking or external API logging is used.
  • Stats are stored in local web storage (LocalStorage).
  • Zero metrics are sent online.
